paragraphs.text: The main hall seats 120 people and is available from 8 am to 11 pm. Hire costs £18 an hour, or £12 for local charities. The kitchen is included, but the projector is charged separately.

Bookings must be confirmed two weeks ahead and paid in full seven days before the event. Music must stop by 10.30 pm. Rubbish should be taken away by the hirer; bins on site are for centre staff only.

items.prompt: A local charity pays less than the standard rate.
Use of the projector is free.
Payment is due on the day of the event.
The hall is cheaper on weekdays.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
